lastText: The Case Is Closed221BThe Return to Baker StreetNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 26THE LAMP LIT AND THE SUPPER LAIDYou come in with your own key, by the old stair, to the room that has not changed. Watson is in the armchair. He does not turn round. He says, in a perfectly steady voice, that you took your time, and you sit down opposite him, and neither of you says anything for the better part of an hour. It is the quietest, kindest return that a man could have had, and it is the only one that you will ever wish to remember. He is remembered as a man who worked alone, because it was easier.
